item.title: Rallying Cry – May 29, 2026
item.description: Rescuers celebrate as the first of five trapped men are saved in Laos, Brazil protects a historic Fordlandia site, Dell’s stock soars on AI-driven sales, and a clever startup offers free home cleanings—if you let them film it for robot training.
